name: kneel_hold
text: Remain kneeling upright on both knees with shins behind on the ground, arms relaxed down beside the thighs. Subtle breathing only, no standing or sitting back.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 双膝跪地、上身直立、双手垂在大腿旁；以稳定姿态全身关键帧生成微动保持段，中间两秒首尾重复。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
